children: France’s annual inflation rate accelerated for a third consecutive month to 3.0% in September 2026, reaching its highest level since February 2024, according to preliminary official estimates.
The reading picked up from 2.4% in August and exceeded market forecasts, which had anticipated an increase to 2.8%.

Separately, domestic producer price data indicated continued upward momentum across upstream sectors, with overall French producer prices rising 1.0% M/M in August, slowing slightly from a 1.3% advance in July.

This growth was driven primarily by mining, quarrying, energy, and water prices, which increased 2.9% following a 3.6% gain in the prior month, while manufactured product prices edged up 0.4%, down from a 0.7% increase in July.

title: France's September CPI hits 3.0% as August producer prices rise 1.0% M/M
